license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, firm, association, company or corporation to act as an adjuster without first obtaining a license pursuant to the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act.

issuing_authority.quote: The Insurance Commissioner shall license as an adjuster only an individual who has fully complied with the provisions of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act

name.quote: The Insurance Commissioner shall license as an adjuster only an individual who has fully complied with the provisions of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act

type.quote: The Commissioner may issue a license to an insurance adjuster or a public adjuster in accordance with the provisions of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Insurance Department may use one or more of the following to review and provide a nonbinding recommendation to the Insurance Commissioner

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.value: experience or special education or training of sufficient duration and extent
degree_required.quote: Has had experience or special education or training of sufficient duration and extent with reference to the handling of loss claims pursuant to insurance contracts to make the applicant competent to fulfill the responsibilities of an adjuster

required.quote: Has had experience or special education or training of sufficient duration and extent with reference to the handling of loss claims pursuant to insurance contracts to make the applicant competent to fulfill the responsibilities of an adjuster

experience_source.quote: Has had experience or special education or training of sufficient duration and extent with reference to the handling of loss claims pursuant to insurance contracts to make the applicant competent to fulfill the responsibilities of an adjuster

exams.name: Adjuster Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must pass examination approved by the Commissioner; exemptions exist for certain nonresident and previously licensed applicants.
exams.quote: Each applicant for a license as an adjuster shall, prior to issuance of said license, personally take and pass, to the satisfaction of the Commissioner, an examination approved by the Commissioner as a test of the qualifications and competency of the applicant.

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued pursuant to the provisions of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act shall continue in force not longer than twenty-four (24) months.

required.quote: Any licensee applying for renewal of a license as an adjuster shall have completed not less than twenty-four (24) clock hours of continuing insurance education, of which three (3) hours shall be in ethics, within the previous twenty-four (24) months prior to renewal of the license.

hours_per_period.quote: shall have completed not less than twenty-four (24) clock hours of continuing insurance education

period_years.quote: within the previous twenty-four (24) months prior to renewal of the license

topical_requirements.quote: of which three (3) hours shall be in ethics

available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 6220 of this title, a nonresident applicant shall receive a nonresident adjuster license if: 1. The applicant has passed an examination in the applicant's home state or in another state in which the applicant is currently licensed and in good standing; 2. The applicant is currently licensed and in good standing in the home state of the applicant

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, have passed an examination in home state or another state where currently licensed, submit proper request and fees, and applicant's home state must award nonresident licenses to Oklahoma residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The applicant's home state awards nonresident adjuster licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining an adjuster's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misrepresentation or fraud in obtaining an adjuster's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which original issuance of a license could have been refused
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any cause for which original issuance of a license could have been refused

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation, conversion, or illegal withholding of fiduciary funds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misappropriation, conversion to the personal use of the licensee, or illegal withholding of monies required to be held by the licensee in a fiduciary capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misrepresentation of insurance contract terms with intent to deceive, or engaging in fraudulent transactions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misrepresentation of the terms and effect of any insurance contract, with intent to deceive, or engaging in, or attempting to engage in, any fraudulent transaction with respect to a claim or loss

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of or pleading guilty or nolo contendere to a felony pursuant to the laws of this state, any other state, the United States, or any foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Shown to be incompetent, untrustworthy, or a source of injury to the public in the conduct of business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee or trainee has shown himself to be, and is so deemed by the Commissioner, incompetent, untrustworthy or a source of injury to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal to comply with any lawful order of the Commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusal to comply with any lawful order of the Commissioner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjusting losses or negotiating claim settlements without proper licensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjusting losses or negotiating claim settlements arising pursuant to provisions of insurance contracts on behalf of an insurer or insured without proper licensing from the Commissioner and authority from the licensed insurer or the insured party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond to any inquiry from the Department within 30 calendar days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond to any inquiry (including electronic communications) from the Department within thirty (30) calendar days of receipt of such inquiry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to any document
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to any document

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly using notes or reference material to complete an insurance license examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or insurance fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or insurance fraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an adjuster license denied, suspended, censured, placed on probation, or revoked in any other state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance adjuster license or its equivalent denied, suspended, censured, placed on probation or revoked in any other state, province, district or territory

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform the Department of a change of address, legal name, or application information within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to inform the Department, by any means acceptable to the Department, of a change of address, change of legal name or change of information submitted on the application within thirty (30) days of the change

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing services as a public adjuster, company adjuster, or independent adjuster on the same claim
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing services as a public adjuster, company adjuster or independent adjuster on the same claim.

bonding_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as a public adjuster or any renewal of the license, the applicant shall file with the Commissioner a surety bond in favor of the people of the State of Oklahoma, executed by a surety company authorized to do business in the state, in the amount of Twenty-five Thousand Dollars ($25,000.00).

definition_quote.value: Public adjuster means any person, firm, association, company, or corporation that suggests or presents to members of the public that said public adjuster represents the interests of an insured or third party for a fee or compensation. Public adjusters may investigate claims and negotiate losses to property only.
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjuster" means any person, firm, association, company, or corporation that suggests or presents to members of the public that said public adjuster represents the interests of an insured or third party for a fee or compensation. Public adjusters may investigate claims and negotiate losses to property only

methods_authorized.quote: Public adjusters may investigate claims and negotiate losses to property only

business_entity_licensure_allowed.quote: A firm, association, company, or corporation shall be licensed only as an adjuster.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: in the case of a corporation, association, or company each individual to act for the corporation, association, or company pursuant to the license, shall be named in the license and shall qualify therefor as though an individual licensee.

resident_vs_nonresident_license_types.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to Section 6220 of this title, a nonresident applicant shall receive a nonresident adjuster license

prohibited_salvage_business_interest.quote: A public adjuster shall not acquire any interest in salvage of property subject to the contract with the insured unless the public adjuster obtains written permission from the insured after settlement of the claim with the insurer.

surety_bond_required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license as a public adjuster or any renewal of the license, the applicant shall file with the Commissioner a surety bond in favor of the people of the State of Oklahoma

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: in the amount of Twenty-five Thousand Dollars ($25,000.00)

written_contract_required.quote: Every contract for services to be rendered by a public adjuster shall be in writing

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: The insured has the right to cancel any compensation agreement entered into with a licensed public adjuster until midnight of the third business day after the day on which the signed agreement was provided to the insured.

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: Any compensation or anything of value in connection with an insured's specific loss that will be received by a public adjuster from any third party shall be disclosed by the public adjuster to the insured in writing including the source and amount of any such compensation.

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: A public adjuster shall not enter into a contract or accept a power of attorney that vests in the public adjuster the effective authority to choose the persons who shall perform repair work.

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: A public adjuster shall not solicit or attempt to solicit an insured during the progress of a loss-producing occurrence.

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: any person violating the provisions of the Insurance Adjusters Licensing Act may be subject to a civil fine of not more than One Thousand Dollars ($1,000.00) for each violation.
